Game Overview

In Data Breach, the core idea is straightforward: unleash chaos as a mischievous computer virus in Data Breach. Navigate through a digital maze, deftly dodging relentless scanners with precise clicks or spacebar jumps. Inspired by Flappy Bird and Jetpack Joyride, this thrilling escapade combines strategy and reflexes for an unforgettable virtual adventure. Can you outsmart the system?
